quest.title: Snapshots
quest.description: Xu of the Feiyun Commerce Guild is currently puzzling over a device known as a Kamera...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Kamera x1

talks.objective: Deliver the picture to the customer

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Kamera... Ah, yes, I did go to the Feiyun Commerce Guild a few days ago — asked them to come here to take a picture of me.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Did you come here specially to deliver my picture? Why, thank you. Thank you very much.

talks.objective: Deliver the picture to the customer

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Ah, right, right. I did go to Feiyun Commerce Guild to request that they take a picture of me here.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: How is it? Has the picture been printed already? Let me have a look at it...

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Oh, this is not bad at all. Thank you for making the trip here.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Have you managed to deliver the pictures?

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Thank you, thank you. I'm sorry for troubling you, but we're barely keeping our heads above the water here...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Please take this Kamera as thanks for your help.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: It's no problem. I mean, you did help us, didn't you?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: This is not an exceedingly expensive object, either. It's just a sample that our partners in Fontaine gave us.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: There are some differences between it and the official model... but the basic functions are all there. It'll definitely be enough for your needs.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: And if you take a liking to it, you can also help us with some advertising here and there...

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Ahem... Regardless, thanks for your help, and please, take this Kamera with you.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: That Kamera device really is something. Hmm, perhaps I should look to purchase one...

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: I wonder how much this Kamera costs. I'm of a mind to buy one myself...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: I wonder how the folks in Fontaine managed to put this clever little thing together? It's so fascinating...
